findings.message: The Records bullet says soft failures 'file their findings through the existing soft-finding Box path', and the Tests bullet requires test_soft_failure_files_and_passes, but no such path exists. Soft gate findings only come back as StageResult.findings: chupa/stages.py check() returns findings=gated.findings on ok, chupa/merge.py:366 returns soft findings, and chupa/runner.py drive() ignores findings on an ok result. The tests/test_stages.py test_gate_bypass_demotes_its_code_to_soft test asserts only that the finding is reported on the result. The box.enqueue sites cover only second problems, base-red results, failure and rework reports, flake, checkpoint, retro and storm reports; none files a soft gate finding. The unit therefore omits the writer and message shape: which module enqueues, the message_class, stage, outcome and summary, the occurrence_id domain that keeps Check retries idempotent, and whether the inline merge path files too (it re-runs HARD entries only). The ticket requires premise_failed in this case and forbids inventing the fact.

Then re-author this ticket's snapshot of the entry hash against the repaired unit. No ticket text needs inventing the fact.
